name: Bunni
overview: The topic of Bunni in Scripture highlights a Levite involved in the religious leadership during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah, as seen when Bunni stood with other Levites to praise God (Nehemiah 9:4). Bunni is also identified as an ancestor of Shemaiah, linking him within a priestly lineage important for teaching and temple service (Nehemiah 11:15). Additionally, Bunni appears as a representative name within a family of Jews, emphasizing his role within the community's genealogical and spiritual heritage (Nehemiah 10:15).
